content.title: Retail Stocks Move Cautiously Higher. Beware the ‘Silly Season.’
content.summary: Retail stocks were on track to post modest gains in Friday’s holiday-shortened trading session.  The SPDR S&P Retail ETF, also known by its ticker, XRT, was up 0.2%, compared with the S&P 500’s 0.3% gain.  Walmart stock was up 0.8%, Costco Wholesale gained 0.5%, and Target rose 1.5%.

content.title: Retailer Recap: Kohl’s Stock Surges After It and Other Chains Hike Guidance
content.summary: ↗️ Kohl’s (KSS): The struggling chain posted a surprise profit and hiked annual guidance on Tuesday, one of a series of retailers to do so. Shares surged more than 42.5%, a day after the company named a new permanent chief executive.

content.title: Best Buy, Kohl's, Abercrombie, & more: Retail earnings takeaways
content.description:
